shots.title: Normalize analyzer, prep, loop, and worktree path expectations on Windows (#509)

hazards.description: Initial full-suite work uncovered both test-only path separator assumptions and product containment checks that used string prefixes instead of native path semantics.

shots.notes: Normalized repository-facing paths to POSIX where SLOPE stores logical repo paths, switched test expectations to native path helpers, and tightened safe path containment using resolved relative paths.

shots.title: Gate adapter executable-bit assertions on platforms with POSIX chmod semantics (#509)
shots.notes: Updated adapter tests to use native hook paths and to skip POSIX executable-bit assertions on Windows while preserving chmod coverage on POSIX platforms.

shots.title: Run and document full-suite Windows validation for #509

hazards.description: Full-suite reruns exposed additional POSIX assumptions in fixture directory creation, git stderr redirection, absolute path detection, and process-heavy timing fixtures.

shots.notes: Removed POSIX shell redirections from affected git probes, added Node-based MCP grep fallback behavior, fixed Windows absolute path handling, closed SQLite handles before temp cleanup, and widened or reduced process-heavy fixture timing.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite still prints legacy stderr noise from negative git/temp-repo probes, but it no longer fails.

training.description: Repository paths and filesystem paths are different contracts.
training.outcome: Repo-facing APIs normalize to POSIX paths, while tests that assert local filesystem paths use native `join`, `resolve`, `dirname`, and `isAbsolute`.

training.description: Suppressing command stderr should use child-process options instead of shell redirection.
training.outcome: Affected git probes now use `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'ignore']`, avoiding Windows `2>/dev/null` failures.

training.description: Windows process spawning is slow enough that large synthetic git fixtures need timing margin.
training.outcome: The git cadence fixture now uses empty commits and fewer commits while preserving the daily-cadence threshold; the PR closeout status helper test has an explicit timeout.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 228 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3596 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, and targeted portability suites passed.
Roadmap S137.5 is marked complete and this scorecard records #509 validation evidence.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A practical recovery pass: lots of small Windows edge cases, but each one pointed to a clearer contract between repo paths, filesystem paths, shell behavior, and platform semantics.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When adding tests that create files, never derive parents by slicing on `/`; use `dirname`. When hiding command stderr, use `stdio` instead of shell redirection.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The final failures were not product logic at all; they were fixture cost and status-helper timing under Windows process spawning.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The S137 retro PR can now carry a green Windows full-suite recovery instead of leaving #509 as an external caveat.

bunker_locations: Do not use string prefix checks for path containment; resolve and compare relative paths.
Do not assume `/` when computing local filesystem parent directories in tests.
Use `isAbsolute` for CLI input paths; Windows drive-letter paths are absolute too.
Use child-process `stdio` options rather than `2>/dev/null` when suppressing git output.
yardage_book_updates: Analyzer, prep, import graph, map inventory, MCP fallback, and vision markdown now normalize repo paths consistently.
Adapter chmod assertions remain active on POSIX and are skipped on Windows.
SQLite memory backend cache cleanup closes cached backends before Windows temp directory removal.
Windows full suite passes locally with `corepack pnpm test`.
course_management_notes: Validation passed: `corepack pnpm prepare`, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm test`, and `slope roadmap validate`.
Issue #509 should be closed by this recovery commit once the PR is merged.
